title: Yara and the Extraction
author: O. M. Zhou
blurb: Rafael Kavanagh, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
